description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
